messages.author: 83b63066408210ec
messages.subject: Multiple cores per chain
parts: Is it possible to parallelise a single chain? That is, make a single chain run in multiple cores? I'd been hoping running a model with four chains on a computer with 16 cores would speed things up but it seems like it limits itself to one chain per core and so takes exactly the same amount of time no matter what I do.

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Multiple cores per chain
parts:
I'm afraid not. We might be able to get some improvements
when we move to Eigen 3.3, which has OpenMP and GPU support.
But that won't be for a while yet.

- Bob
